summary: STRATEX MVP end-to-end test. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASSED (root, project CRUD, caliper math both branches and boundary, insurance 20/25 + retail 10/10 pricing with Xactimate tags, preflight rejection 400, launch success with Claude-generated agent reports, persistence). Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Emergent LLM Key is live — produced ~1000-char, multi-sentence forensic/validation/reconciliation/jurisprudential narratives referencing actual ANOM IDs, thermal deltas, $ totals, Xactimate tags, and KY OSHA/IRC code citations. Frontend: Landing, Nav (Command/New Mission/Projects/Fleet/Reports), Projects list (8 project links), Reports list (4 mission reports), Fleet page, and Mission Dashboard (3D photogrammetry image, 6-anomaly grid with severity color chips, 4 AI agent narrative panels, full locked Quant table with all 10 Xactimate tags and 20/25 O&P bands totalling $41,440.36) all render correctly. Color palette compliant: no purple offenders detected; matte obsidian #06080B background, cyber teal #00F0FF accent, volt green & plasma orange present. Wizard Steps 1/2/3/5 work and caliper alert flips between tear-off / overlay at the >1.00" boundary correctly. ONE CRITICAL UX BUG: Step 4 (Quant Pricing) renders a blank page because pricing is fetched only when the user CLICKS Continue from step 4, then setStep(5) advances immediately — so the in-wizard pricing line-item table is never shown to the user. (The post-launch Mission Dashboard does show the full pricing table, so the data is fine.)

ui_bugs.issue: Step 4 renders empty. `next()` for step 3 only does `submitCaliper` + `setStep(4)`; the pricing API call lives inside the step==4 branch of `next()`, so it only runs when the user clicks Continue FROM step 4, after which `setStep(5)` immediately advances. The render condition `{step === 4 && pricing && ...}` therefore never evaluates true and the user sees a blank step between progress bar and Back/Continue. The Quant pricing line-item table + Xactimate tags + final total are never visible inside the wizard.
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Move `const pr = await computePricing(project.id); setPricing(pr);` into the step===3 branch (right after submitCaliper) and then `setStep(4)`. Then change the step===4 next() handler to simply `setStep(5)` (no API call). Alternatively use a `useEffect` that fires when `step === 4 && !pricing` to fetch.

action_items: Fix NewMission.jsx step-4 empty render: compute pricing when entering step 4 (move the computePricing call into the step 3 handler, or use a useEffect that runs when step becomes 4 and pricing is null), so the wizard's Quant pricing table is visible before the user clicks Continue.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — preflight check requires `drone_battery_percentage >= 100` (strict 100). Realistic demo should likely accept >=90 to allow toggling in UI; right now any toggle on a single field will fail launch with 400.
server.py — `generate_agent_reports` falls back silently if LLM JSON parsing fails; consider logging the raw response for observability when re.search match fails.

NewMission.jsx — line 47: `edgeThickness` initial value is a number (1.15), but later code uses `parseFloat(edgeThickness)` everywhere and the input is type=number; works but stringified onChange means initial 1.15 may render as `1.15`. Minor.
Projects.jsx & Reports.jsx — empty-state UX is fine. No missing data-testids on critical action elements.
MissionDashboard.jsx — solid implementation; consider adding data-testid='mission-pricing-table' on the tbody for easier future automation (currently only `mission-pricing-lock` is exposed).
server.py — no input validation that `edge_thickness_in` is > 0; negative or 0 values silently classify as overlay. Low priority for demo.

success_rate.frontend: 85% — landing, nav, projects list, reports list, fleet, mission dashboard, caliper step, preflight all green; only Step 4 wizard render is broken.

seed_data_creation: Test fixtures created several TEST_-prefixed projects via API (one insurance with tear-off 1.25", one retail overlay, one boundary 1.0", and one full launch with Claude reports). These remain in `test_database.projects` for inspection. Project IDs visible at /projects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid and fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_stratex_api.py (run with pytest -v --tb=short). Claude Sonnet 4.6 narrative path is live and returns rich multi-sentence JSON. Only one frontend fix needed: NewMission.jsx step-4 wizard must compute pricing on entering step 4 so the in-wizard pricing table renders. After fix, re-run the wizard E2E (intake -> scope -> caliper 1.25 -> verify pricing table visible -> launch) and confirm `/mission/{id}` opens with all 4 agent panels populated.
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE — NewMission.jsx step-4 blank screen: In `next()` (lines 59-95), the call `const pr = await computePricing(project.id); setPricing(pr);` is inside `else if (step === 4)`. When the user is on step 3 and clicks Continue, only `submitCaliper` + `setStep(4)` run. React advances to step 4 with `pricing === null`, so the render `{step === 4 && pricing && (<HudCard>...pricing table...)}` short-circuits and shows nothing. When the user clicks Continue again, pricing is fetched but `setStep(5)` immediately advances, so the user never sees step 4 content. REPRO: /mission/new -> Continue -> Continue -> enter 1.2 -> Continue. STEP 4 IS BLANK. MITIGATION: relocate `computePricing` to either (a) the step===3 branch right after `setCaliper(c)` so pricing is ready when step 4 mounts, or (b) a `useEffect(() => { if (step===4 && !pricing && project) { ... } }, [step])`.
